## MRaiders change summary
Describe behavior changed, affected map(s), source/provenance, and backwards compatibility.

## Verification
- [ ] Qt native build attempted (link CI run or exact local commands)
- [ ] CTest and JSON validations attempted
- [ ] If UI changed: screenshot or concrete manual test notes
- [ ] No game memory access, injection, active capture, or anti-cheat bypass
- [ ] New coordinates clearly marked as candidate or cited/verified
- [ ] IP/license review completed for maps, iconography, and other external assets

## Evidence / known gaps
List actual outcomes and blockers. Don't represent untested builds as passing.
